podcast.title: Original Contributor, Later Credit Dispute
podcast.body: Ron Grainer was a colleague of Delia Derbyshire at the BBC Radiophonic Workshop. He supplied rudimentary melodies for the "Doctor Who" theme. However, his contribution was so basic that he reportedly did not even recognize the final, fully electronic version after Delia Derbyshire's extensive compositional and production work. Despite this, he was initially the only one credited for the iconic theme. "el propio Ron Granier ni siquiera reconocía la pieza."

srcs.episode: Cómo una mujer inventó la música electrónica ⧸ Delia Derbyshire
